    duplicate_decompose_guard [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.guard_duplicate_decompose" label="Fail closed duplicate decomposition attempt" output_key="__goal_duplicate_decompose_guard_result" output_format="json" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="goal_run" action_node_id="duplicate_decompose_guard" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]

    encode_issue_urls_b64 [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode issue urls packet payload" output_key="issue_urls_b64" action_value="${issue_urls}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]

    hard_planning_gate [shape="diamond" label="Hard planning approved?"]
    hard_planning_hold_done [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.inspect_json" label="Emit hard planning hold outcome" output_format="json" outputs="planning_state,planning_artifact_path,planning_review_required,goal_admission_reason" action_raw="{\"planning_state\":\"${planning_state}\",\"planning_artifact_path\":\"${planning_artifact_path}\",\"planning_review_required\":\"true\",\"goal_admission_reason\":\"${goal_admission_reason}\"}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    intake_decompose [type="pipeline" label="Intake and decompose goal" export_keys="goal_issue,goal_context,approved_features,external_bug_report,external_bug_errors,external_bug_present,external_bug_intake_activated,review_notes,approved,decompose_attempts,decompose_parse_status,decompose_parse_error,decompose_proposed_excerpt,decompose_parse_source" inherit_context="true" pipeline="@hatch/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/goal_intake_decompose/goal_intake_decompose.workflow-source.mjs" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.pipeline"]
    issues [type="pipeline" label="Write issues" export_keys="issue_urls" inherit_context="true" pipeline="@hatch/capability-goal-decomposition/workflows/write_issues/write_issues.workflow-source.mjs" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.pipeline"]
    keep_open [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.post_retry_comment" label="Leave goal open for retry" output_key="__keep_open_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_approved_feature_count="${approved_feature_count}" action_decompose_approved="${approved}" action_decompose_attempts="${decompose_attempt_number}" action_decompose_parse_source="${decompose_parse_source}" action_decompose_parse_status="${decompose_parse_status}" action_issue_count="${issue_count}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    keep_open_direct [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.post_retry_comment" label="Leave direct easy goal open for retry" output_key="__keep_open_direct_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_approved_feature_count="0" action_decompose_approved="false" action_decompose_attempts="0" action_decompose_parse_source="${__composite_reason}" action_decompose_parse_status="direct_execution_failed" action_issue_count="0" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    label_issues [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.label_created_issues" label="Add triaged label to created issues" output_format="json" outputs="label_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_issue_urls="${issue_urls}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    mark_decompose_attempt [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.post_decompose_attempt" label="Mark decompose attempt" output_key="__mark_attempt_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_decompose_attempt_number="${decompose_attempt_number}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    mark_dispatched [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.mark_dispatched" label="Mark goal dispatched" output_key="__mark_dispatched_result" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_issue_number="${issue_number}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    materialize_hard_plan [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.materialize_approved_plan" label="Materialize approved hard plan into issues" output_format="json" outputs="goal_issue_number,goal_issue,goal_context,approved_features,plan_packet_id,planning_artifact_path,decomposition_packet_id,decomposition_packet_path,materialization_state,already_completed,issue_urls,created_issue_numbers,feature_issue_map,blocked_by_edges,traceability_chain,materialization_packet_path,materialization_packet_id,planning_state,goal_execution_path_packet_id,goal_execution_path_packet_path,awaiting_human_label_removed" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_goal_number="${issue_number}" action_plan_packet_id="${hard_plan_packet_id}" action_planning_artifact_path="${hard_plan_packet_path}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    normalize_issue_index [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="triage.normalize_issue_urls" label="Normalize issue index from URLs" output_format="json" outputs="normalized_issues" action_issue_urls="${issue_urls}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    persist_decomposition_packet [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.persist_decomposition_packet" label="Persist goal decomposition packet" outputs="goal_decomposition_packet_path,goal_decomposition_packet_id,goal_decomposition_packet_type,goal_decomposition_packet_schema_version,goal_decomposition_packet_storage_class" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_goal_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_run_id="${__run_id}" action_pipeline="goal_run" action_node_id="persist_decomposition_packet" action_approved_features_b64="${approved_features_b64}" action_control_plane_repo="${control_plane_repo}" action_goal_context_b64="${goal_context_b64}" action_goal_issue_b64="${goal_issue_b64}" action_issue_urls_b64="${issue_urls_b64}" action_target_repo="${target_repo}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    resolve_deps [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="triage.resolve_feature_dependencies" label="Resolve feature dependencies to issue numbers" output_format="json" outputs="resolved_feature_issue_map" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_feature_issue_map="${feature_issue_map}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    resolve_execution_path [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="software.resolve_goal_execution_path" label="Resolve canonical goal execution-path metadata" output_format="json" outputs="goal_issue_number,goal_execution_path,goal_routing_state,goal_execution_path_version,classification_version,goal_execution_path_packet_id,goal_execution_path_packet_path,goal_execution_path_source,understanding_risk,rationale_required" action_repo="${repo}" action_goal_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_goal_execution_paths="${goal_execution_paths}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    resolve_hard_goal_state [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="goal.inspect_hard_state" label="Resolve hard-goal planning/re-entry state" output_format="json" outputs="hard_goal,hard_goal_state,hard_goal_state_reason,hard_plan_packet_present,hard_plan_packet_id,hard_plan_packet_path,hard_plan_comment_marker,hard_plan_comment_id,hard_plan_comment_url,hard_plan_artifact_count,hard_plan_artifact_refs,ready_label_present,awaiting_human_label_present" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_repo_root="${repo}" action_goal_issue_number="${issue_number}" action_goal_execution_path="${goal_execution_path}" action_goal_routing_state="${goal_routing_state}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    set_empty_issue_urls [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Set empty issue urls for direct goal path" output_key="__set_empty_issue_urls_result" prompt="printf '[]'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    set_goal_execution_mode_direct [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Mark direct easy execution mode" output_key="__set_goal_execution_mode_direct_result" prompt="printf 'direct'" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond"]
    zip_feature_map [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="triage.zip_features_to_issues" label="Zip features to created issues" output_format="json" outputs="feature_issue_map" action_approved_features="${approved_features}" action_normalized_issues="${normalized_issues}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}.tool"]
    encode_goal_issue_b64 -> encode_goal_context_b64 -> encode_approved_features_b64 -> encode_issue_urls_b64 -> persist_decomposition_packet -> normalize_issue_index -> zip_feature_map -> resolve_deps -> label_issues -> apply_feature_blockers -> compute_close -> decide_close
    keep_open -> done
    mark_dispatched -> done
    start -> resolve_execution_path -> resolve_hard_goal_state -> admission_check -> admission_gate
    admission_gate -> easy_execution_gate [condition="goal_admission_allowed=true"]
    admission_gate -> fail_duplicate_admission [condition="goal_admission_allowed!=true"]
    append_rationale_feature -> issues
    approved_hard_plan_resume -> encode_goal_issue_b64
    check_already_decomposed -> check_decompose_retries [condition="has_sub_issues!=true"]
    check_already_decomposed -> done [condition="has_sub_issues=true"]
    check_decompose_retries -> duplicate_decompose_guard
    clear_direct_execution_reason -> execute_easy_goal
    count_approved_features -> count_issues
    count_issues -> decomposition_feature_gate
    current_decompose_attempt -> decompose_retry_gate
    decide_close -> keep_open [condition="should_close!=true"]
    decide_close -> mark_dispatched [condition="should_close=true"]
    decompose_retry_gate -> exhaust_decompose_retries [condition="decompose_retry_count>=3"]
    decompose_retry_gate -> mark_decompose_attempt [condition="decompose_retry_count<3"]
    decomposition_feature_gate -> decomposition_issue_gate [condition="approved_feature_count!=0"]
    decomposition_feature_gate -> keep_open [condition="approved_feature_count=0"]
    decomposition_issue_gate -> encode_goal_issue_b64 [condition="issue_count!=0"]
    decomposition_issue_gate -> keep_open [condition="issue_count=0"]
    direct_execution_result_gate -> keep_open_direct [condition="__composite_reason=child_failed"]
    direct_execution_result_gate -> mark_dispatched [condition="__composite_reason!=child_failed"]
    duplicate_decompose_guard -> current_decompose_attempt
    easy_execution_gate -> check_already_decomposed [condition="goal_execution_path=medium"]
    easy_execution_gate -> hard_planning_gate [condition="goal_execution_path=hard"]
    easy_execution_gate -> set_goal_execution_mode_direct [condition="goal_execution_path=easy"]
    execute_easy_goal -> set_empty_issue_urls
    exhaust_decompose_retries -> done
    fail_duplicate_admission -> done
    hard_plan -> hard_planning_hold_done
    hard_planning_gate -> hard_plan [condition="planning_state!=approved"]
    hard_planning_gate -> materialize_hard_plan [condition="planning_state=approved"]
    hard_planning_hold_done -> done
    intake_decompose -> append_rationale_feature
    issues -> count_approved_features
    keep_open_direct -> done
    mark_decompose_attempt -> intake_decompose
    materialize_hard_plan -> approved_hard_plan_resume
    set_empty_issue_urls -> direct_execution_result_gate
    set_goal_execution_mode_direct -> clear_direct_execution_reason
}
